create_boxes_from_tensor: create a Boxes object from a Nx4 torch.Tensor of (xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax) coordinates
compute_pairwise_iou: compute pairwise IoU between all N x M pairs of boxes from two Boxes objects
convert_box_mode: convert boxes between XYXY_ABS, XYWH_ABS, and XYWHA_ABS coordinate formats
clip_boxes_to_image: clip a set of boxes to stay within image height and width boundaries
compute_pairwise_intersection: compute intersection area between all N x M pairs of boxes from two Boxes objects
